description.value: The Captain's Boil is a Cajun-style seafood boil franchise restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, where diners choose their catch, sauce flavour, and heat level for a hands-on, communal feast experience. Part of a growing Canadian chain with locations across BC, Alberta, Manitoba, and Ontario, this location offers indoor seating and accepts cash, credit, and debit. It is a sit-down seafood destination rather than a quick-stop cyclist café.
